description: Visitor-facing view of what analytics is doing on this page: whether it runs, why it is off, and which fields an event carries, with a Pause / Resume control.

attributes.name: heading-level
attributes.description: Level of the panel heading; the field-list subheading is one level below (max 6)

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Tighter layout (smaller heading, text and buttons) for embedding alongside other UI

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Reflected runtime state: active (sending), debug (console transport), paused (visitor paused this tab), off (any other reason)

attributes.name: data-reason
attributes.description: Reflected when analytics is not sending: why

events.name: analytics-panel:optout
events.description: Fired when the user pauses analytics for this tab

events.name: analytics-panel:optin
events.description: Fired when the user resumes analytics for this tab
